node.flavourText: "And you... there was no excuse for your actions. You defiled them! You have tainted the very sands with the blood of your own! Yet the war rages on. You have achieved nothing. You must pay." \n\nVarashta condemned Kelari to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.
